live.heatmap_help: Shows how deep every key is pressed, with the peak held for a moment (red line) and how often it went down. Keys still type while the view runs; it stops when you leave this page.
live.tester_help: Click the box and press keys: what the computer receives is shown on the board. Keys pressed at least once stay tinted.
live.cal_help: Calibrates every key's travel range. After starting, press each key fully down once and release it, then click Finish. Use it after changing switches or switch types.
live.cal_confirm: Start any-key calibration? The keyboard measures each key's travel again; until you click Finish, keys may not work normally. Press every key fully down once, then click Finish.
live.cal_unknown: The keyboard did not report a result. Check the keys in the live view.
